datasetTitle: 臺北市橋梁檢測及維修資料
sourceAgency: 臺北市政府工務局新建工程處

coordinateCoverage.note: The source contains no coordinates or bridge geometry, and no reliable existing project join was found. No bridge locations are mapped.

limitations: This source is a published bridge inspection and maintenance record. Older inspection information is not a safety classification; maintenance spending does not measure danger; and a maintenance record does not by itself establish a structural problem.
